spotlights.heading: Volume Plugin
spotlights.summary: Volume Plugin: enabling pods to seamlessly access and use data stored on ScaleIO volumes.

spotlights.heading: Volume Plugin
spotlights.summary: Volume Plugin: adding the capability to use Portworx as a storage provider for Kubernetes clusters. Portworx pools your server capacity and turns your servers or cloud instances into converged, highly available compute and storage nodes.

spotlights.heading: Daemon set updates
spotlights.summary: Daemon set updates: lets you perform rolling updates on a daemon set

spotlights.heading: Out-of-tree cloud provider
spotlights.summary: Out-of-tree cloud provider: support adds a new cloud-controller-manager binary that may be used for testing the new out-of-core cloud provider flow

spotlights.heading: Per-pod-eviction
spotlights.summary: Per-pod-eviction: in case of node problems combined with tolerationSeconds, lets users tune the duration a pod stays bound to a node that is experiencing problems

spotlights.heading: Pod Injection Policy
spotlights.summary: Pod Injection Policy: adds a new API resource PodPreset to inject information such as secrets, volumes, volume mounts, and environment variables into pods at creation time.

spotlights.heading: Custom metrics
spotlights.summary: Custom metrics: support in the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler changed to use

spotlights.heading: GPU support
spotlights.summary: GPU support: is introduced with the Docker runtime only
